notes: Universal slot picks - a cross-class starting frame drawn from community gearing guides. Treat these as seed examples and verify each item's exact stats, source, faction availability, and current-meta status at authoring time.

shoulderStrategy.note: At 19 nearly every build runs the same shoulder plan: take the highest-armor BoE shoulder your class can wear (a stat-less vessel), have a level-60 apply a Scourge shoulder inscription to it, then mail it to the twink. The inscription (a Naxxramas shoulder enchant) carries the stats and has no level requirement; the vessel just needs to be BoE so it can be mailed after enchanting. The right vessel is the best armor type you can equip; the right inscription depends on the build's role (melee/caster/healer/tank).
